rationale: Filterable first-party register of all BS-applied legal acts; canonical A3 entry point for SI banking and payments rules.
Top-level supervision hub whose sub-streams branch from it; good node for detecting new supervisory sections.
Static explainer page under the supervision hub; little standalone signal beyond its parent.
SREP/SEP/stress-test cycle and annual letters to banks — dense recurring deadline generator.
Mandatory CRD supervisory disclosures map EU rules to SI transposition and national discretions.
Payments-side oversight and PI/EMI/AISP registers under ZPlaSSIED; core payments-actor deadline source.
Payments umbrella hub (SEPA, instant payments, digital euro) — early signal of forthcoming payments rules.
NSP minutes publish migration timetables and industry positions ahead of formal regulation.
Reporting-obligation catalogue with legal basis and recurring submission calendars.
Versioned XML schemas with effective dates are machine-readable leading indicators of reporting-rule change.
Static archive of superseded instructions; mine once for rule-history reconstruction, not a live stream.
Press/news layer announces Council decisions and consultations first; offers email push subscription.
Macroprudential sklepi carry forward-dated application and phase-in deadlines for banks.
Statutory FOI catalogue indexing the BS general-act corpus; mine once as a lead index.
Official gazette carries the legally binding text and entry-into-force dates; verify the post-Feb-2026 pipeline change.
Consolidated national legal register with amendment chains and stable act IDs; authoritative current text.
State consultation portal where SI banking/payments draft laws open with explicit comment windows.
Resolution and deposit-guarantee stream generates MREL, contribution and reporting deadlines distinct from prudential.
AML/CFT carries the densest near-term deadline flow for SI banks and payment institutions.
Sanctions notices with same-day implementation obligations; high-tempo but narrow notice stream.
Enforcement register of measures on named institutions reveals where compliance pressure actually lands.
Periodic publications hub with regulatory retrospectives and a forward release calendar for scheduling.
Curated sitemap; mine once to enumerate all bsi.si pages, then re-check occasionally for new sections.
English mirror is a subset of the SL master site; useful for terminology, not a separate stream.
Bank association news reveals industry positions on draft rules; indirect, corroborate against first-party acts.
Securities supervisor binding banks as investment firms — clearly in scope, but URL check failed; re-verify liveness.
Single consultation notice, not a recurring feed; monitor the ATVP news index instead once reachability is confirmed.
